copper mountain.note: Happy Football Sunday, Copper Mountain! We received 2 inches of new snow in the last 24 hours , all of which fell during the day yesterday. With a fresh layer of snow on the mountain, we can look forward to some soft, corduroy turns this morning! Today, expect cooler temperatures, with a high near 25°F at the Aerie . Southwest winds will remain light to moderate throughout the day, with gusts reaching into the upper 20 mph range . Yesterday we opened our first beginner terrain of the season, including the Easy Rider carpet and learning area! If you're heading out for your first few days on the slopes, this is a great place to get comfortable and find your ski or snowboard legs again. As we continue to expand terrain throughout the season, stay up to date by following our Copper Mountain Terrain Updates channel on Instagram . Looking ahead to Thanksgiving, JJ's will be hosting a Thanksgiving dinner buffet this Thursday! The menu looks delicious, so be sure to make your reservations by emailing jjs@coppercolorado.com . Enjoy the soft snow, have a great Sunday, and we'll see you on the mountain!

eldora.note: LET’S GO. Eldora Mountain officially opens Tuesday, November 24! A huge thank you to every member of our team for the hard work it takes to get this mountain ready for another season. And an extra-special shoutout to our snowmaking crew, who have worked tirelessly to squeeze every flake possible out of every snowmaking window. Here’s what to expect Tuesday: Lifts: 9 AM–4 PM (Alpenglow lift only) Lodges: 8 AM–4 PM (Timbers, West Wing, and Lower Indian Peaks Lodges only) 1,000 vertical feet of intermediate terrain off Alpenglow, including Hornblower and International A small Woodward Terrain Park in the base area There will be no beginner terrain, Nordic skiing, snowshoeing, or uphill access at opening. More terrain will come online as snowmaking and natural snowfall allow. Early-season conditions apply, so please respect all closures and signage and follow Your Responsibility Code. Check out our blog for all the details! Check out the full AlpenGuy saga on our YouTube channel! Been slacking on getting your pass? Summer pricing ENDS soon! Shop now at Eldora.com . See you on the mountain on Tuesday!

snowbird.note: Guess what all you skiers & snowboarders? Snowbird is opening early! Wax those boards, waterproof those jackets and get ready to ride. The new Opening Day is Wednesday, November 25. Resort Update: All uphill travel is CLOSED for snowmaking and winter 2026-27 on-mountain preparation. Snowbird is scheduled to open for lift-serviced operations on November 25. Mountain Report: Season Passholders, don't forget about your Early Bird Benefit (Passholder's who bought/renewed by May 13). Your free night at The Cliff Lodge is valid through December 17. The first couple of weekends of ski season are always exciting ones, so get your stay on the books while availability allows. The mountain is white. Snowmaking is underway. Opening Day is getting closer. Give me The Bird
